description: I’m redoing the shower drains on this project. I do 4 to 5 revolutions of primer and cement on my fittings and pipe. This can be messy, so I wear Ironclad CleanFit nitrile gloves with a textured grip. I highly recommend for plumbing work #plumbing #plumbingtips #showerremodel
